1660 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
06-17-1660 minus 49 weeks = 49 × 7 = 343 days.  
Plus 3 more days = 346 days before 06-17-1660.  

Count back:  
June 17 → June 1 is 16 days back (June 17 - 16 = June 1).  
Remaining days: 346 - 16 = 330 days before June 1, 1660.  

From June 1, 1660:  
May 1660 has 31 days → back to May 1 is 31 days (330 - 31 = 299 left).  
April has 30 → 299 - 30 = 269 left.  
March has 31 → 269 - 31 = 238 left.  
February (leap) has 29 → 238 - 29 = 209 left.  
January has 31 → 209 - 31 = 178 left.  

Now into 1659:  
December 1659 has 31 → 178 - 31 = 147 left.  
November 30 → 147 - 30 = 117 left.  
October 31 → 117 - 31 = 86 left.  
September 30 → 86 - 30 = 56 left.  
August 31 → 56 - 31 = 25 left.  
July 31 → 25 - 31 = -6 (means we go into July 6 days before July 31).  

July 31 minus 6 days = July 25, 1659.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1659-07-25
